name: HSBC Holdings
title: FY 2025 Fixed Income Investor Call - Transcript

read.thesis: Bank reports record FY25 PBT $36.6bn and 17.2% RoTE, but CET1 falls 110bp to just below the 14–14.5% range after Hang Seng privatisation, with buybacks suspended up to three quarters.

triggers.label: RoTE target 17% or better to 2028
triggers.quote: We are targeting a return on tangible equity at 17% or better each year to 2028, also excluding notable items.

triggers.label: 11 business exits announced, 4 completed
triggers.quote: In 2025, we announced 11 business exits, and four of these have been completed to date.

triggers.label: Banking NII at least $45bn in 2026
triggers.quote: For 2026, our guidance for Banking NII is at least $45 billion

triggers.label: CET1 dips below 14–14.5% range
triggers.quote: that effectively recognises a 110 basis points drop in the CET1, so that takes us just marginally below our target operating level

guidance.value: rising towards 5% by 2028, excl. notable items

red_flags.label: Stage 3 loans up to 2.5% of loans
red_flags.quote: Stage 3 balances were 2.5% of customer loans, up marginally on the 2.4% level last year.

red_flags.label: CET1 below target range post Hang Seng
red_flags.quote: that takes us just marginally below our target operating level

red_flags.label: Hong Kong CRE pain points
red_flags.quote: There are still pain points, particularly in commercial real estate.

evasions.topic: Timing of CET1 return to range
evasions.quote: I'm not going to give you a timeline for that
So no clear guidance that I can give you today on when we will resume share buybacks
There are no set plans, really, in terms of Tier 2 or currency at the moment.
